item: Read seam: queries.py reads through KeywordMentionRead
summary: The largest reader of the keyword rows (117 references, read-only) now goes through the read-only KeywordMentionRead model over the keyword_mentions_all view instead of the write model; behaviour-neutral (458 related tests pass), conjunction.py (which imported the model through queries.py) moves with it, and the seam ratchet's two entries are removed.
